name: Planning for the Future Core Strategy and Urban Core Plan for Gateshead and Newcastle upon Tyne 2010-2030

housing-numbers.notes: Joint plan with combined targets. 30,000 total homes excluding purpose-built student accommodation. Approximately 21,600 homes in existing built-up area, 8,400 in Neighbourhood and Village Growth Areas. Annual rate of 1,500 homes per annum mentioned.
